subject.title: feat(feishu): bot-to-bot conversation support with @mention handling

question: Should Feishu ship bot-authored message admission as the omitted default accept mode with loop protection, or require a more restrictive explicit allowBots mode before bot-to-bot replies are admitted?
rationale: This PR changes a live channel admission/default surface and transport notification behavior; the code can implement either policy, but automation cannot choose the product default for existing Feishu operators.

options.title: Preserve accept default after refresh
options.body: Keep omitted allowBots as accepting bot-authored messages to preserve current admission behavior, relying on self-filtering and botLoopProtection as the upgrade guard.

options.title: Default to mention-only bot admission
options.body: Change the omitted or documented default so bot-authored messages dispatch only when the Feishu bot is explicitly mentioned.

options.title: Require explicit bot admission
options.body: Make bot-to-bot participation require allowBots: true or allowBots: "mentions" so granting the Feishu scope alone does not admit peer bots.

recommendation.title: Preserve accept default after refresh
recommendation.body: Keep omitted allowBots as accepting bot-authored messages to preserve current admission behavior, relying on self-filtering and botLoopProtection as the upgrade guard.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu runtime history and current-main blame make this the strongest available owner for the channel policy decision.
